experiment_data.hypothesis: Full M2 StarCoder: 3 strategies × 3 seeds on full M1 data. Cross-encoder validation — if embedding > random holds for both Qwen and StarCoder, method is encoder-agnostic. Resolves plan_013 pilot negative (dataflow encoder-dependent).

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/structfuse && bash run_m2_full_starcoder.sh 2>&1 | tee /root/runs/structfuse-context/m2_full_starcoder.log"

experiment_data.notes: Phase 1: 构建 StarCoder embedding negatives 中。数据输出: /root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/full_m2_starcoder_data/。Random/dataflow 复制 Qwen，仅 embedding 用 StarCoder2-3B 重算。Phase 2: 9 runs 训练，batch_size=4, num_negatives=5, epochs=2, lr=2e-5, eval_steps=500。双 checkpoint: best + best_by_recall_at_1。Checkpoint: /root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/checkpoints/m2_full_starcoder/。Seeds: 42,43,44.
